irregularities.title: 14 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: Roster index pruned 3 record(s) no current source supports
irregularities.detail: The player index is pruned each run: a (club, player) record is dropped when the official report names the player under a different club and no current source still asserts it, or when no source has asserted it for 14 days. Dropped this run: WAS:rasul-douglas (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); BUF:trent-sherfield (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); NO:brock-rechsteiner (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days). This is the guard against stale records mis-attributing in-game events (see the 2026-09-16 HOU/GB misattribution in the README verification log).

irregularities.title: 58 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. Examples: A to Z Sports said ACTIVE for Josh Simmons (official: see link); Yahoo Sports said ACTIVE for Lamar Jackson (official: see link); Bucs Report said QUESTIONABLE for Emeka Egbuka (official: see link); Panthers.com said IR for Taylor Moton (official: see link); Yahoo Sports said QUESTIONABLE for Jahmyr Gibbs (official: see link)
